content.title: 7-1-3-6. Noise.
content.summary: Noise generated on the site must not exceed the levels permitted in the City Code, except that a WCF owner or operator shall be permitted to exceed City Code noise standards for a reasonable period of time during repairs, not to exceed two hours, without prior authorization from the City.
